highlights: Comprehensive Child Safeguarding Handbook and Policy
Staff criminal background checks and safe recruitment vetting
Staff and volunteer Safeguarding Codes of Conduct
Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) and social and emotional counsellors
Duty of care including campus access control
safety.policy_summary: The school enforces a robust Student Safeguarding Handbook and policy aligned with international guidelines (such as ITFCP, UNCRC, and UK statutory guidance). It outlines clear definitions of abuse, procedures for staff vetting, criminal background checks, recruitment screening, codes of conduct for all adults and visitors, and multi-disciplinary responses to handle disclosures or protect student welfare.
